# `silk/platform/native/host_input`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Owned copies of the command-line arguments and the environment of the process.

## When to use
The native runtime captures a [`NativeHostInput`](#NativeHostInput) at start, and gives it to `main` as an
`OsHostInput`. Use [`NativeHostInput.environmentSnapshot`](#NativeHostInput.impl.environmentSnapshot) in a library that gets no arguments,
or [`NativeHostInput.capture`](#NativeHostInput.impl.capture) in a custom runtime.

## Details
A capture copies all bytes, so later lookups do not use the memory of the process. The working
directory is read at each call, not captured.

## Errors
`HostInputError` if the input is not valid. `OutOfMemoryError` if a copy cannot be allocated.

## Gotchas
- The capture functions are unsafe. The input vectors and their strings must stay readable and
  unchanged during the capture. No other code can change the environment at that time.
- The module is empty on targets other than Darwin on x86_64 or aarch64, and Linux with GNU libc on x86_64
  or aarch64.

## Examples
### Copy the environment
```silk
import silk.mem.allocator { Allocator, OutOfMemoryError }
import silk.collections.bytes { Bytes }
import silk.core.effect { Effect }
import silk.system.host_input { HostInputError }
import silk.platform.native.host_input { NativeHostInput }
import silk.core.option { Option }

effect fn program() -> i32
  ! HostInputError | OutOfMemoryError
  ? &mut Allocator {
  // Copy the environment. No other code changes the environment now.
  let inputs = run unsafe NativeHostInput.environmentSnapshot()
  if NativeHostInput.argumentCount(&inputs) != 0 {
    return 1
  }

  // An empty output asks only for the length.
  let mut empty: [u8; 0] = []
  let missing = NativeHostInput.variable(&inputs, b"SILK_DOC_NOT_SET", &mut empty)
  match move missing {
    Option.Some {..} => {
      return 1
    }
    Option.None => {}
  }
  let directory = run NativeHostInput.workingDirectory()
  if Bytes.length(&directory) == 0 {
    return 1
  }
  return 0
}

effect fn failed<E>(error: E) -> i32 {
  drop error
  return 1
}

pub fn main() -> i32 {
  let mut allocator = Allocator.systemAllocatorProvider()
  return run Effect.catchAll(program(), failed) |> Effect.provideMut<Allocator>(&mut allocator)
}
```

Import as `NativeHostInput` with `import silk.platform.native.host_input { NativeHostInput }`.

## `NativeHostInput`

```silk
pub struct NativeHostInput
```

An owned copy of the command-line arguments and the environment of the process.

### When to use
The native runtime captures one at start, and gives it to `main` as an `OsHostInput`. Use
[`NativeHostInput.environmentSnapshot`](#NativeHostInput.impl.environmentSnapshot) in a library that gets no arguments, or
[`NativeHostInput.capture`](#NativeHostInput.impl.capture) in a custom runtime.

### Details
A capture copies all bytes, so later lookups do not use the memory of the process. The
working directory is read at each call, not captured.

### Gotchas
The capture functions are unsafe. The input vectors and their strings must stay readable and
unchanged during the capture. No other code can change the environment at that time.

<a id="NativeHostInput.impl.environmentSnapshot"></a>

### Associated function `environmentSnapshot`

```silk
pub unsafe effect fn environmentSnapshot() -> NativeHostInput ! HostInputError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Copies the environment of the process, with no arguments.

#### Gotchas
No other code can change the environment during the call. A null environment gives no
variables.

<a id="NativeHostInput.impl.captureProcess"></a>

### Associated function `captureProcess`

```silk
pub unsafe effect fn captureProcess(argc: i32, argv: [*]const ?[*]const u8) -> NativeHostInput ! HostInputError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Copies `argc` arguments from `argv`, and the environment of the process.

#### Gotchas
`argv` must have `argc` readable entries, each a NUL-terminated string that does not change.
No other code can change the environment during the call. If it fails, all copies are freed.

<a id="NativeHostInput.impl.capture"></a>

### Associated function `capture`

```silk
pub unsafe effect fn capture(
      argc: i32,
      argv: [*]const ?[*]const u8,
      environment: [*]const ?[*]const u8
    ) -> NativeHostInput ! HostInputError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Copies `argc` arguments from `argv`, and the entries of `environment` up to its null entry.

#### Gotchas
Each non-null entry must be a NUL-terminated string that does not change during the call. If
it fails, all copies are freed.

```silk
pub fn argumentCount(self: &Self) -> usize
```

Returns the number of arguments, with the program name if there is one.

<a id="NativeHostInput.impl.argument"></a>

### Method `argument`

```silk
pub fn argument(self: &Self, index: usize, output: &mut [u8]) -> Option<usize>
```

Copies the start of argument `index` to `output`, and returns its full length, or `None` if
there is no such argument.

#### Details
An empty argument returns `Some(0)`. If `output` is too short, only its length is copied,
and the bytes after the copy are not changed.

<a id="NativeHostInput.impl.variable"></a>

### Method `variable`

```silk
pub fn variable(self: &Self, name: &[u8], output: &mut [u8]) -> Option<usize>
```

Copies the start of the value of the first variable named `name` to `output`, and returns
its full length, or `None`.

#### Details
The name must match byte for byte. An empty value returns `Some(0)`. A name with NUL or `=`
never matches. Entries without `=` are ignored.

<a id="NativeHostInput.impl.workingDirectory"></a>

### Associated function `workingDirectory`

```silk
pub effect fn workingDirectory() -> Bytes ! HostInputError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns the current working directory of the process.

#### Details
It starts with a 256-byte buffer, and makes it larger when the path does not fit, up to 1
MiB.

#### Errors
`OutOfMemoryError` if a buffer cannot be allocated. `HostInputError` for other failures.

<a id="NativeHostInput.impl.workingDirectoryCopy"></a>

### Associated function `workingDirectoryCopy`

```silk
pub effect fn workingDirectoryCopy(output: &mut [u8]) -> usize ! HostInputError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Copies the start of the working directory to `output`, and returns its full length. The
bytes after the copy are not changed.
